shortDescription: Module to manage affinity groups in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster of the affinity group.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: host_enforcing
options.description: If I(yes) VM cannot start on host if it does not satisfy the C(host_rule). This parameter is support since oVirt/RHV 4.1 version.

options.name: host_rule
options.description: If I(positive) I(all) VMs in this group should run on the this host. If I(negative) I(no) VMs in this group should run on the this host. If I(disabled) this affinity group doesn't take effect. This parameter is support since oVirt/RHV 4.1 version.

options.name: hosts
options.description: List of the hosts names, which should have assigned this affinity group. This parameter is support since oVirt/RHV 4.1 version.

options.name: hosts_labels
options.description: List of the hosts lable names, which should have assigned this affinity group.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the affinity group to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the affinity group be present or absent.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: vm_enforcing
options.description: If I(yes) VM cannot start if it does not satisfy the C(vm_rule).

options.name: vm_rule
options.description: If I(positive) I(all) VMs in this group should run on the host defined by C(host_rule). If I(negative) I(no) VMs in this group should run on the host defined by C(host_rule). If I(disabled) this affinity group doesn't take effect.

options.name: vms
options.description: List of the VMs names, which should have assigned this affinity group.

options.name: vms_labels
options.description: List of the hosts lable names, which should have assigned this affinity group.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
